title: Ускорим запрос

negative.why: индекс на столбце, который запрос не использует

negative.sql:
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT m.pizza_name AS pizza_name, max(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY rating ORDER BY rating ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS k FROM menu m INNER JOIN pizzeria pz ON m.pizzeria_id = pz.id ORDER BY 1,2;
